name: agent-deck
description: A live side panel of the session's subagents (model, current activity, context, time) and a progress bar above the prompt. /subagents opens or closes the panel.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel by itself
autoOpen.description: on: opens the panel when a new batch of subagents starts; off: only with /subagents

stepReports.title: Step-based progress
stepReports.description: on: asks each subagent to report its steps (a real progress bar per agent); off: an indeterminate bar while it runs

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: agent: each subagent gets its own color; type: subagents of one type share a color
